
 Usage: agentos controller [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 The controller: one MCP URL for every node.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init           Create or update controller.toml (tokens are kept unless      │
│                missing).                                                     │
│ serve          Run the controller until Ctrl-C.                              │
│ join-token     Make a single-use join token and print the line to run on the │
│                new node.                                                     │
│ login          Print a one-time sign-in link for the panel (valid for 10     │
│                minutes).                                                     │
│ nodes          Enrolled nodes and when each was last seen.                   │
│ anchors        The audit checkpoints that nodes keep here, each with this    │
│                controller's signed receipt (its proof of                     │
│                storing it).                                                  │
│ agent-token    Show how to connect an agent (the token lives in              │
│                controller.toml, mode 600).                                   │
│ freeze         Freeze every node under this controller: online nodes at      │
│                once, offline ones when they connect, before                  │
│                anything else runs there. Every agent grant under it is       │
│                revoked.                                                      │
│ unfreeze       Lift the controller's freeze on every node (never a freeze    │
│                made on a node itself). Restores                              │
│                no grant.                                                     │
│ freeze-status  Whether the controller's freeze is on, and which nodes have   │
│                it.                                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
